_comment: Hashes only, never firmware. stock: the official 1010music files a version builds on. releases: the bento1.bin a default build of that version must produce (tools/make_kit.py compares). image_commit: the commit that image was built and tested from; device_tested: true once that image passed its DEVICE_CHECKLIST on hardware (make_kit says MATCH against a hardware-tested image only then); the release tag may sit on a later commit that changes only docs and scripts (same image).
